module.title: Upper-atmosphere thermosphere-ionosphere models GITM and MGITM
entrypoints: UA/GITM standalone auto_test, Makefile test_earth/test_rcmr_quick/test_mars/test_hime, test.Short and WPGITM suites
UA/MGITM: gitm_earth, gitm_earth_1d, gitm_earth_3d, gitm_earth_eclipse, gitm_mars, gitm_mars_1d and gitm_mars_3d
test12 with MGITM; test3 with GITM is attributed to swmf-mit-coupling for its coupling physics
module.expensive_path: GITM's 3-D lon-lat-alt thermosphere advance with chemistry, electrodynamics and radiative terms, and MGITM's corresponding 3-D upper-atmosphere update; GITM production grid and simulated-hour window are compile/run knobs.
module.rationale: GITM and MGITM are the approved upper-atmosphere code family. GITM's public Electrodynamics dependency is vendored with it. The two models reach the coverage floor together and are one upper-atmosphere leaf, while GITM's coupled test3 is graded by the coupling leaf.
excluded: UA/GITM2 legacy version (unclaimed, not selected by the approved tests)
GITM decks requiring non-vendored Aurora or tidal tables
hazards: Top-level GITM install order and the Electrodynamics path must be repaired in the build recipe; the current pinned source has the ModIE API mismatch in coupled SWMF.exe.
GITM committed reference logs are stale against the pinned source and are not truth; references are generated in-container.
GITM grid is compile-time; every grid is a separate configuration/build.
